newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht clings to 32/dlr late despite c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht clings to 32/dlr late despite c.bank.

text.p: The statement by the a central bank executive barely lift the gloom on baht as the Thai unit still hovered around 32.00 level late on Friday, dealers said.
The baht was quoted around 32.0540-32.200 baht per dollar, slightly firmer from the morning when it touched a day low of 32.35.

Deputy central bank governor Chaiyawat Wibulswasdi said on Friday that at the 32.00 per dollar, the baht was already too low. He also said he did not expect the beleagured currency to fall much lower.
Chaiyawat attributed the baht's steady decline this week to expectations by Thai exporters that the currency would be dealt a further setback which stopped them from selling the dollar.
"The baht has declined to 32 to the dollar and the BOT believes it has depreciated more than it should have," Chaiyawat said.
"Although there is possibility of its further fall depending on various factors, exporters should not expect the baht to fall further," he added.
